newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries steady at lower levels at midday.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries steady at lower levels at midday.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were lower at midday on Monday, almost unchanged from opening levels even after a closely watched measure of manufacturing activity rose more strongly than expected.
The 6-1/2 percent 30-year bond was down 7/32 to 101-21/32 shortly after midday, its yield at 6.38 percent, unchanged from opening levels.
Profit-taking kept the market under a little pressure in quiet trade, strategists said.
